name: Emilio Villoresi
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, youthful open face, slight build, keen eager expression
bio: Younger brother of Luigi and, in the judgement of many at Alfa Corse, the faster of the two. 'Mimi' Villoresi gave the Alfa Romeo 158 its first victory at the 1938 Coppa Ciano. He was killed testing at Monza in June 1939, aged 24, and Luigi very nearly gave up racing because of it.
